- When collection_strategy is selenium (FACEBOOK_REELS_FEED), first call existing _collect_ytdlp with the same cookies_browser, cookies_file, ydl_cls, should_stop, log, on_entries, etc.

- Empty list or any extract error: log a short fallback message and run the existing scrape_reel_urls Selenium path unchanged.
- StopRequested / user abort must NOT fall back to Selenium; re-raise.
- Do not open Chrome for already-listed Download rows (download path is unchanged).
- Update collection_strategy docstring if needed. Keep strategy value 'selenium' so tests know Facebook feeds still may use Chrome; or add 'ytdlp_then_selenium' only if you update all tests.
- Tests (no network, no Chrome): (1) ytdlp returns entries -> scrape_reel_urls NOT called; (2) ytdlp empty or raises -> scrape_reel_urls IS called (existing facebook tests should still pass if they patch scrape OR you also patch _collect_ytdlp to fail/empty); (3) StopRequested from ytdlp does not call scrape.
- Run: uv run python -m unittest discover -s tests -v
Return files changed, behavior, tests, remaining risk.

jobs.title: Instagram profile, reels tab, and reposts
jobs.prompt:
User cannot extract Instagram feeds. Errors:
- ERROR: Unsupported URL: https://www.instagram.com/2002chii_/reels/?hl=en
- ERROR: [instagram:user] 2002chii_: Unable to extract data
- ERROR: Unsupported URL: https://www.instagram.com/2002chii_/reposts/?hl=en
They want profile, /reels/ tab, and /reposts/ tab. qt.qpa.mime clipboard retry is unrelated; ignore.

Root cause: _classify_instagram treats username/reels as SINGLE because segments[1] in ('p','reel','reels','tv'). yt-dlp has no extractor for /username/reels or /username/reposts. Profile instagram:user often needs cookies; then it should fall back to Selenium like Facebook.

Do this:
1. Fix _classify_instagram:
   - SINGLE: /p/CODE, /reel/CODE, /tv/CODE, /stories/..., /username/p|reel|tv/CODE
   - FEED: /username/, /username/reels, /username/reposts (and tagged if easy)
   - Do NOT classify /username/reels as SINGLE
2. normalize_source_url: strip Instagram tracking query (hl=en and similar) but keep the tab path (reels/reposts).
3. collection_strategy: Instagram FEED uses same 'selenium' strategy as Facebook (yt-dlp first, Chrome if empty/error). StopRequested must not open Chrome.
4. When calling _collect_ytdlp for Instagram:
   - Bare /username/ : use that URL
   - /username/reels : rewrite to https://www.instagram.com/username/ for yt-dlp (InstagramUserIE only accepts the profile). If ytdlp returns items, skip Chrome (posts+reels mix is OK).
   - /username/reposts : do NOT rewrite to profile (wrong content). Skip or fail yt-dlp and scrape the reposts page.
5. Extend scrape (scrape_reel_urls or sibling): Instagram login message; harvest a[href] matching /p/, /reel/, /tv/ (not the profile/reels/reposts tab itself). Reuse Chrome profile. Keep Facebook /reel/ harvest working.
6. Tests, no network: classify/normalize for the three user URLs; collect ytdlp success skips scrape; ytdlp fail/empty calls scrape; reposts does not treat profile rewrite as success; harvest unique IG post URLs. Run uv run python -m unittest discover -s tests -v
Return files, behavior, tests, risk.
Do not commit. Do not edit .cursor/job.json.
acceptance: /username/reels and /username/reposts classify as feeds not singles
yt-dlp first then Selenium for Instagram profile/reels; Selenium for reposts if yt-dlp cannot list them
Facebook scrape still works
Unit tests pass without network
jobs.notes: Done: IG profile/reels/reposts as feeds; ytdlp then Selenium; 232 tests OK.

jobs.title: Fix Twitter photos and Douyin cookies
jobs.prompt:
User download errors (platforms are supported; extract is failing):
1. ERROR: [twitter] 2085223295776100697: No video could be found in this tweet
2. ERROR: [Douyin] 7681950375104610226: Fresh cookies (not necessarily logged in) are needed
They said: fix platform not support.

Context:
- yt-dlp TwitterIE skips photos (`type != photo`) then raise_no_formats('No video could be found in this tweet'). Image tweets must still download as images.
- FORMAT_SELECTOR is bv*+ba/b (video+audio) which also cannot pick photos.
- Douyin extractor needs s_v_web_id cookies. We impersonate chrome but do NOT pass --cookies-from-browser unless the user set Settings. write_netscape_cookies defaults domain to .kuaishou.com for a raw cookie line, so Douyin paste never matches .douyin.com.

Do this (no network in tests; mock urllib):
A) Twitter
- Keep yt-dlp first for video tweets.
- For twitter/x.com, add --extractor-args twitter:api=syndication (guest/public) in addition to existing args; still use cookies if the user set them.
- Twitter format: use a selector that still prefers merged video+audio but can fall back (e.g. bv*+ba/b/best) — do not break Bilibili.
- If yt-dlp exits non-zero for a twitter URL, fallback: resolve status id, GET a public tweet-media JSON (try api.fxtwitter.com/status/{id} then api.vxtwitter.com/Twitter/status/{id}), download photo (and video if JSON has mp4) files into the same output_dir with id in the filename. Mark done if at least one file saved. Do not treat image tweets as unsupported.
- media_kind: x.com/twitter.com /status/.../photo/ is image.
B) Douyin
- If cookies_browser and cookies_file are both empty, auto --cookies-from-browser chrome for douyin (and kuaishou).
- Keep --impersonate chrome.
- write_netscape_cookies: if curl/url host is douyin, use .douyin.com; if raw cookie line with no host, write the same cookies for .douyin.com AND .kuaishou.com (and existing host if any) so paste works for both.
C) Tests for _yt_dlp_args twitter extractor-args and format; douyin auto cookies-from-browser; netscape domains; twitter fallback with mocked HTTP writing a jpg; media_kind photo tweet. uv run python -m unittest discover -s tests -v

Return files, behavior, tests, risk.
